text:
incident-bot: ALERT: model-serving error rate spike detected for model_id=redwood/gpt-v3-quantized variant=v3-quant (5m error rate 12%, baseline 0.4%) — paging sre-oncall
sre-oncall: on it — acknowledging. pulling logs and metrics now. can someone from ML infra join?
ml_infra_lead: I see the same. 95th latency OK but error is tokenization mismatch in ffwd path for quantized kernels. reproducing locally now.
nicole: tagging in. I can temporarily nudge traffic away from the quantized variant. want weight -> 0 or full disable?
sre-oncall: target = minimize customer impact while keeping throughput. start with immediate weight shift to stable variant and also add per-key throttling for heavy customers.
ml_infra_lead: agreed. plan: 1) set v3-quant weight=0 2) route traffic to v3-safe variant 3) set short-term rate limits for top 10 keys 4) kick off rollback patch for quant kernels
jason: I can take the quota/rate-limit changes. Nicole, can you do the routing change?
nicole: doing routing change now. running rtxctl to update traffic split.
```bash
# set variant weight to zero for that model
rtxctl traffic set-weight --model redwood/gpt-v3 --variant v3-quant 0 --reason "emergency disable - error spike"
```
nicole: rtxctl responded: "OK — traffic policy updated (txn=0x7f3a). new default routes point to v3-safe"
deploy-bot: notice: traffic update applied by nicole at 2026-03-15T15:12:03Z.
ml_infra_lead: verify fallback compatibility for recent schema changes — v3-safe supports the same runtime flags?
nicole: yes, v3-safe is fully compatible. sampling shows requests now hitting v3-safe. error rate for overall model dropped to 0.9% within 30s.
sre-oncall: good. now implementing per-key throttles for top offenders to reduce burst load while we investigate root cause. jason, please apply limits: 50 qps per key for top10, expire in 2h.
jason: applying via policy API. snippet: ```json
{ "policy": "per_key_rate_limit", "keys": ["acct:big-corp-1","acct:high-q-2"], "limit": "50/s", "ttl": "2h" }
```
jason: APPLIED — policy id pol-88b2. Logs show enforcement starting.
product-support: Quick question — any customer-visible errors or 502s? Support queue seeing a handful of "model error" tickets from enterprise customers, nothing widespread yet. I can queue a batch notification if needed.
sre-oncall: not many 502s. majority were internal model errors. we should still notify top-tier customers that we detected an anomaly and have moved them to a stable variant; offer to open a support follow-up. carla can you draft a short message?
carla: on it. draft: "We detected an anomaly with one model variant and routed your requests to a stable variant to avoid impact. No action required; please let us know if you see any regressions." sending to product team for review.
ml_infra_lead: root cause debugging notes: reproducer points to a race between cached KV shape and quantized kernel init on long-context requests. looking into early fix. will probably need a micro-patch and validated unit tests.
sre-oncall: any chance we can re-enable quantized variant with a safe gate (canary keys only)?
ml_infra_lead: not yet — until we patch the kernel, re-enabling risks reintroducing errors. better keep at weight=0. we can create a canary with synthetic traffic after patch.
nicole: tagging config that was changed for runbook: 
```yaml
- change: traffic weight 0 for v3-quant
  actor: nicole
  time: 2026-03-15T15:12:03Z
  txn: 0x7f3a
- change: rate limit policy pol-88b2 applied by jason
  keys: top10
  ttl: 2h
```
nicole: also pushed a console annotation and created an incident note in the dashboard: "v3-quant disabled due to error spike"
sre-oncall: handing off to matt for the 30m monitoring window and follow-up while I go to the pager rotation brief. matt — can you watch alerts for next 60m and escalate if error rate climbs above 2%?
matt: taking handoff. I'll keep watch and coordinate with ML infra. set a reminder at +30m to reassess.
ml_infra_lead: starting a debug build for the quant kernel. ETA ~90m for a candidate. will run regression job and small canary when ready.
product-support: Customer comms approved. sending to affected customer list now.
nicole: quick note — I also temporarily raised the per-account quota for accounts that saw degraded outputs when we rerouted to ensure they didn't hit quota denial while retrying. We'll revert after stabilization.
jason: quotas reverted for safe accounts when we confirmed stable variant behavior; leaving throttles on for heavy keys only.
ml_infra_lead: after we validate patch in staging we will: 1) run synthetic canary traffic against v3-quant 2) if green, roll with 1% traffic to canary variant for 30m 3) progressively increase weight. we will only re-enable after zero regression on eval set and low error rate in canary.
sre-oncall: sounds good. summary for incident note: "Emergency: disabled v3-quant variant due to 12% error spike. Traffic routed to v3-safe; per-key throttles applied for top offenders; quotas adjusted for affected accounts; ML infra building patch. No major customer outage; targeted enterprise notifications sent."
carla: I'll attach the draft comms and timeline to the incident doc.
matt: monitoring — overall model error at 0.6% and stable. keeping watch.
ml_infra_lead: thanks everyone. I'll post updates in this thread when the candidate is ready.
sre-oncall: leaving channel. matt is on rotation. incident-bot: incident severity set to P1 -> P2 (impact contained).
incident-bot: RESOLVED: traffic mitigation applied; variant disabled and throttles in place (final status pending patch).
carla: closing loop — created postmortem skeleton and assigned owners for RCA.
nicole: leaving ops note with rollback commands in case we need to re-disable quickly. ```bash
rtxctl traffic set-weight --model redwood/gpt-v3 --variant v3-quant 0 --force
rtxctl traffic set-weight --model redwood/gpt-v3 --variant v3-safe 100
```
nicole: thanks all.
